verifier_partition.rationale: AST, SemanticConsistency, and Z3Math use explicit rules/logic without trained weights. SOSKANEnergyV3 and SemEnergyProbe use trained models/probes.

fields.full_ensemble_auroc: Positive control -- must reproduce frozen 0.9131 (+/-0.01) or the ablation is unfaithful and the deltas are meaningless.
fields.formal_only_auroc: The contamination-free moat floor -- AUROC from SAT/Z3/AST/liveness with NO trained weights; robust to the DT-Q4 OOD-contamination critique.
fields.learned_only_auroc: The learned-probe contribution -- high here + low formal = the moat leans on probes that may be OOD-advantaged on the strong model's error topology.
fields.verifier_partition: Records which verifier was classified FORMAL vs LEARNED (+ rationale) so the decomposition is auditable + reproducible.
fields.n_candidates_scored: The AUROC deltas are only meaningful at the same N the 0.9131 headline used.
fields.preconditions_checked: Records which resources (cached corpus, ensemble code) were verified before running; pre-empts the lacked-resource-so-fabricated mode.
fields.random_seed: Determinism precondition for third-party reproduction of the deltas.
fields.reproducibility_checksum: Content hash of (corpus id, partition, N, seed) catches silent drift vs any replication.
fields.duration_s: Verifier-scoring over the corpus takes wall-clock; implausibly short = fabrication signal (floor 1s for this substrate).
